headline: Joe Mama Angie Daddy Hangs 187 on Meredith's Fan Club, Wins by 112.65
meme_brief: One team's starting quarterback throws for a monster day and it still isn't even the best part of the box score — the other team loses by more than a football team's average total. The final margin is bigger than the loser's actual point total.
recap:
Joe Mama Angie Daddy put up 187.95 points this week, the largest score in the league, and turned what should have been a normal Sunday into a rout of Meredith's Fan Club, winning by 112.65. Brock Purdy, started at quarterback, went for 48.25 points to lead all scorers league-wide, and Jahmyr Gibbs added 40.9 on top of it. Meredith's Fan Club got a solid 25.4 from Patrick Mahomes but had nowhere near enough around him, finishing at 75.3.

The closest game of the week belonged to Broke Dak Mountain, who survived Silverbacks by 6.15 points, 120.5 to 114.35. Both teams got real production — Silverbacks rode a 22.6-point outing from Harold Fannin and 21.3 from Ja'Marr Chase — but Broke Dak Mountain's night was nearly derailed by its own lineup card, more on that below. Pukachu Chews You delivered the week's other blowout, beating demon44 by 94.9, 173.1 to 78.2, with Bijan Robinson (36.3) and Jordan Love (28.6) doing the heavy lifting.

The worst bench decision of the week, in a field with no shortage of candidates, belongs to Broke Dak Mountain, who started Josh Allen (23.0 points) over Sam Darnold, who sat on the bench and put up 45.45. That's a 22.45-point gap left on the table in a game the team still won by only 6.15 — the margin for error was thinner than it looked. Dak to the Future has a similar story: Tyler Shough went off for 39.35 from the bench while Dak Prescott started and scored 24.7, a 14.65-point swing that mattered in a 12.4-point loss to Screaming Eagles. Meredith's Fan Club also left 18.5 points on the bench with Jordan Addison sitting behind a 1.7-point Emmett Johnson, though it wouldn't have flipped a 112-point loss either way.
transaction_desk:
The waiver wire was quiet this week — most of the week's moves cost nothing, since they were uncontested pickups. The one exception was demon44, who spent their own dead-last priority slot (12 of 12) on the Cincinnati Bengals defense. Burning the worst possible priority number is close to a freebie, and the Bengals have already returned 3.0 points in their first week aboard — not a heist, but not a loss either given what it cost.

The more interesting story is what's already on the books. Chuba Bucky Doo's free-agent pickup of Kirk Cousins has returned 33.7 points in a single week for zero priority cost, which is about as good as a waiver-wire quarterback streamer can perform. mikelanta's earlier addition of Jacoby Brissett is now sitting on 46.85 cumulative points across two weeks for a move that cost no priority at all — that's a legitimate heist at the position, and it's a big reason mikelanta keeps outscoring its record. On the other end, Joe Mama Angie Daddy's early-season use of a waiver claim on Malik Davis has produced exactly zero points through three weeks — priority spent for nothing, though it's ancient history at this point.

standings_narrative:
Through three weeks, the division winners hold the top three seeds: Joe Mama Angie Daddy (Diamonds), Chuba Bucky Doo (Hearts), and Broke Dak Mountain (Clubs) are all 2-1 and sit at the top of the bracket as currently constructed. The next two seeds by record go to Long Live King Henry and Dak to the Future, both also 2-1 but edged out of their divisions by the teams above them.

The sixth and final seed doesn't go to the next-best record — it goes to whoever has scored the most points among the teams left over, and right now that's mikelanta, at 1-2 but sitting on 419.35 points, more than every other team outside the top five except Chuba Bucky Doo. Waffle House is the closest team on the outside looking in, also 1-2 but well back on points. Pukachu Chews You, Screaming Eagles, Silverbacks, demon44, and Meredith's Fan Club round out the group currently outside the playoff picture, though demon44's 2-1 record — buried behind two stronger division winners — is a reminder that record alone isn't guaranteeing a seed here.
look_ahead: Week 4 features Chuba Bucky Doo against Pukachu Chews You, and Joe Mama Angie Daddy on the road against demon44, who will be looking to answer this week's blowout loss. Broke Dak Mountain gets Dak to the Future in a matchup of two 2-1 teams, while Waffle House faces Screaming Eagles and Silverbacks takes on mikelanta. Long Live King Henry and Meredith's Fan Club round out the slate.
